plan: OpenVibe Seven Domains Plan (2026-11-07) §8, M1: Stalwart receiving, masks, burners and agent inboxes; HO6 (channels): an agent answers the mail sent to its own address
runtime: node 22, express, PostgreSQL 18 (openvibe-sdk/db), Stalwart Community 1.0.3 (AGPL-3.0-only), local filesystem blobs (S3 optional)
domain: openvibe.email; receive-only MX. The API and the pages are public through nginx (deploy/nginx/openvibe.email.conf): a home page at /, the signed-in inbox at /inbox (and /inbox/settings), and the owner's provider panel at /admin/mail/providers.

stalwart.blobStore: local filesystem /var/lib/openvibe-stalwart/blobs by default (STALWART_BLOB_STORE=fs); S3-compatible optional (Backblaze B2 in production, MinIO in CI)
stalwart.listeners: SMTP 25 inbound; JMAP/management 8080 and IMAP 143 on loopback; no submission, POP3, Sieve or HTTPS listener
stalwart.directory: SQL over mail_directory_accounts: every burner is its own account (name = burner address); masks and agent inboxes are aliases of the owner's mailbox

eventsPayload: mail.mask.created and mail.received are metadata only: neither carries a subject, body or code. mail.agent_inbox.received (HO6) carries the subject and a plain-text excerpt of at most 4000 characters for an inbox whose answering switch the person turned on; never the HTML, never an attachment, and nothing at all for spam or a blocked sender
privacy: a burner's mail is isolated by its own Stalwart account, never by sender-written To/Cc/Delivered-To headers
the shared person mailbox matches only the first Delivered-To header Stalwart stamps
message bodies are never logged, stored by this service, served as HTML or put in an event; the messages API returns metadata only
a mask never forwards outside OpenVibe
the code extractor is the only reader of a body and drops it immediately
an expired burner's mail and account are deleted by a due-based purge job; a failure keeps the row for the next run
an agent's reply is recorded with its outcome (mail_sent_mail) and carries no attachment; a message body reaches an event only as the excerpt of an inbox whose answering is on
an IMAP app password is sealed with AES-256-GCM under MAIL_SECRETS_KEY (owner and connection id as AAD) before the INSERT; no API answer or log line carries it
an IMAP mailbox is read only: EXAMINE and BODY.PEEK, no STORE, MOVE, EXPUNGE or DELETE, and the TLS socket resolves through openvibe-shared/egress so a private address is refused

tests.unit: node test/run.js (PGlite, in-process Network and mail server)
tests.acceptance: node test/stalwart/run.js (pinned Stalwart + PostgreSQL, fs blobs by default and one S3 CI run; SMTP delivery, code, forged To/Cc/Delivered-To isolation, 300-message isolation, expiry account deletion and bounce, disabled-mask bounce, 404s, no body in logs, blob on disk)
tests.frontdoor: node test/frontdoor.test.js (CORS allow-list, same-site cookie write rule, /me/mail)
tests.imap: node test/imap.test.js (TLS required, private target refused, the seal is not returned or logged, UID resume, UIDVALIDITY reset, disconnect with and without the pulled summaries)

deployment: Public at https://openvibe.email: deployed with ovhost deploy mail (docs/INSTALL.md has the steps and docs/DNS.md the records). The unit runs as the house user on 127.0.0.1:5250 with the env in /etc/openvibe/mail.env.
security: the API is behind OpenVibe.Network auth; typed tokens are refused
Stalwart runs in its own systemd slice: MemoryMax=1G, CPUQuota=100%, NoNewPrivileges, ProtectSystem=strict
the mail server has no password-authenticated listener and no relay: domains are allowRelaying=false and the submission/POP3/Sieve/HTTPS listeners are removed
a cookie-authenticated write must come from openvibe.email (Sec-Fetch-Site/Origin)
CORS is an exact allow-list from the Contracts manifests; no wildcard and no credentialed cross-origin request

publicApi.pages: / is the home page, /inbox and /inbox/settings are the signed-in person's inbox, /admin/mail/providers is the owner's panel
publicApi.cors: Bearer from any first-party origin in the Contracts manifests; cookie writes only same-origin on openvibe.email; the browser extension's own origin when MAIL_EXTENSION_ORIGINS names it

agentMail.switch: off by default, per agent; the poll walks only inboxes whose switch is on
agentMail.poll: due-based, under its own lease in mail_settings; a message is announced once (the row and the event commit together)
agentMail.skips: a message the mail server marked as spam, a sender on the person's block list, and the inbox's own address
agentMail.reply: POST /internal/mail/agents/:agent_id/reply (mail.agent.reply), from the inbox address, to the sender only, plain text
agentMail.delivery: a reply to the owner's own openvibe.email addresses (mailbox, masks, burners) is handed to the mail server over loopback SMTP. Sending outside OpenVibe is not ours yet (plan M2, waiting on the owner): MAIL_OUTBOUND=on is the only way on and it is OFF by default, so with it off such a reply opens no connection and answers 409 mail.outbound_closed, which the agent's system turns into the person's send approval (the reply waits, nothing is sent, nothing is lost)
agentMail.outbound: GET /internal/mail/outbound says whether Mail may send outside OpenVibe, so an approval card can say plainly that the reply will wait
